kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَرَنْجَبِين or تَرَنْجُبِين • (taranjabīn or taranjubīn) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Classical Persian ترنگبین (tarangubin, tarangabin), ترانگبین (tar-angubin, tar-angabin, “Persian manna”), from تر (tar, “moist”) + انگبین (angabin, angubin, “honey”).
g: Persian mannaplant, Alhagi maurorum syn. Alhagi persarum
a saccharine honeydew forming on this plant, effective as a laxative, cholagogue and immunostimulant
